fact: The ICR of 24 December 2019 reports a new EMIS (SIGE) established with data from all schools entered, a computer and internet connection supplied to all schools with electricity (about 66 of 88 primary schools), head teachers trained, and about 70,000 student IDs created; a 2018 external assessment found unreliable internet at several schools limiting use, and the system was donor-financed (World Bank, GPE).
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report: Quality Education for All Project
